translations.web: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.
translations.bsb: When you approach a city to fight against it, you are to make an offer of peace.
translations.kjv: When thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace
translations.asv: When thou drawest nigh unto a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace unto it.
